test_title: PYST 44: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b7bd17104cf32b1a02ed2687a465abc4b8c3e41ac9d7784eae4b08041955809.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

When we compare the figures 1 and 3 we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b7ee832cfd73d8dea1469a2ac79cfbf637a3bfe53320dffd834bb198c07558.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice downwards such that 1 and 6 are visible we find that on the left we have 2 and on the right we have 5 which means they both are opposite to each other. So **5 is the number on the face opposite the face showing 2.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**
